newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bundesbank sets 14-day repo tender at 3.00 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bundesbank sets 14-day repo tender at 3.00 pct.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Tuesday it was setting a tender for 14-day securities repurchase funds, offering banks liquidity at a fixed three percent rate.
Funds will be credited to accounts tomorrow and the securities have to be repurchased on September 18.
A 69.0 billion mark facility set at a fixed 3.30 percent rate expires on Wednesday.
A 14-day facility set last week carried a fixed interest rate of three percent.
